verdict.rationale: BILL's platform covers AP alongside Spend & Expense. It documents bill approval policies that control which bills need approval, by whom, and when, plus custom approval policies on the pricing page. It also documents end-to-end bill-to-payment workflows, ACH and check disbursement (BILL prints and mails checks), bulk and mass payments, and international payments. missing for 10: explicit wire-transfer support, detailed invoice-capture documentation (beyond AI bill coding and creating bills via API), independent or hands-on corroboration.
